title: 5-item global navigation, PracticeModeTabs switcher, and /explore redirect

spec.problem: Desktop header and mobile bottom bar expose diverging 5+dropdown/hamburger navigation with an /analytics redirect stub, /quiz and /exercises lack a unified Luyện thi switcher, and /explore duplicates search/reference navigation.

acceptance.text: AC1: LearnerAppFrame renders the exact 5 canonical primary nav items identically on desktop header and mobile bottom bar (Trang chủ /{locale}, Học tập /{locale}/levels active on /levels|/scenarios|/news|/radar, Ôn tập /{locale}/flashcards?tab=review when dueCount > 0 else /{locale}/flashcards with due badge, Luyện thi /{locale}/quiz active on /quiz|/exercises|/battle, Tra cứu /{locale}/search active on /search|/dictionary|/kanji|/grammar|/saved), removes the desktop Khám phá dropdown, mobile top-left hamburger menu, and /analytics item, keeps top-right Avatar -> /{locale}/me and its /daily-standup item untouched, and updates footer learning links to the 5 pillars plus Gói dịch vụ (/pricing).

AC2: Shared PracticeModeTabs renders at the top of /quiz (quiz-client.tsx) and /exercises (exercises-page-client.tsx) with Tab 1 Thi thử & Đề BJT (/{locale}/quiz), Tab 2 Bài tập kỹ năng nhanh (/{locale}/exercises), and a quiet right-aligned Đấu phản xạ cùng Bot -> link (/{locale}/battle), highlighting the active mode per route.

AC3: app/[locale]/explore/page.tsx server-redirects to /{locale}/search while keeping explore/_components/explore-client.tsx on disk; app/sitemap.ts (+ sitemap.test.ts) removes explore; and helpPage.faq3a in vi/en/ja messages (+ help-copy.test.ts) references Luyện thi instead of the removed menu.

AC4: Unit tests cover the 5-item nav active-route/due-link/clutter-removal contract, PracticeModeTabs on /quiz and /exercises, /explore redirect, sitemap, and help copy, and verify-frontend passes with zero new lint/test/contrast debt.

spec.expected_behavior: Desktop and mobile navigation render the identical 5 canonical pillars (Trang chủ, Học tập, Ôn tập with due-aware href and badge, Luyện thi, Tra cứu) with no Khám phá dropdown, no mobile hamburger menu, and no /analytics tab; footer learning column lists the 5 pillars plus Gói dịch vụ (/pricing); /quiz and /exercises share PracticeModeTabs at top with quiet /battle link; /explore server-redirects to /{locale}/search; explore is removed from sitemap.xml; helpPage.faq3a references Luyện thi.
spec.observed_behavior: LearnerAppFrame renders Home, BJT Roadmap, Practice (/exercises), Review (/flashcards without ?tab=review), and Progress (/analytics redirect stub) plus a desktop Khám phá dropdown and mobile top-left hamburger menu; /quiz and /exercises have no shared mode switcher; /explore renders ExploreClient and appears in sitemap.xml; helpPage.faq3a points learners to old menu labels.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert LearnerAppFrame, PracticeModeTabs + quiz/exercises header mount, explore/page.tsx redirect, sitemap.ts, and nav/practiceModes/helpPage message updates; unmounted explore components remain on disk.

classification.rationale: Web-only global navigation consolidation, shared PracticeModeTabs header on /quiz and /exercises, /explore server redirect, sitemap update, and i18n copy updates with no API, DB, auth, or component file deletions.
